label: Blues Rock / Alternative Rock with Soul influences

cards.mood: The piece opens with a somber, introspective mood defined by sparse instrumentation and restrained vocals.
cards.palette: A clean electric guitar with a bluesy tone establishes the harmonic foundation in the intro and verses, switching to a heavily distorted, overdriven sound for the choruses to drive the energy.

lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Shadows stretch across the dusty floor
She stands alone behind the heavy door
The clock is ticking like a steady heart
Waiting for the truth to fall apart
[Pre-Chorus]
The wind begins to howl and moan
She faces the unknown on her own
[Chorus]
Break the silence, let the thunder roll
Fire is burning in her weary soul
The weight of the world is pulling tight
She is dancing in the middle of the night
[Verse]
A single spark ignites the hollow air
She finds the strength that's hiding there
The ghosts of yesterday begin to fade
She faces every debt that must be paid
[Pre-Chorus]
The clouds are heavy, dark and deep
Promises are secrets she must keep
[Chorus]
Break the silence, let the thunder roll
Fire is burning in her weary soul
The weight of the world is pulling tight
She is dancing in the middle of the night
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
In the hush of the midnight rain
She finds the beauty inside the pain
[Chorus]
Break the silence, let the thunder roll
Fire is burning in her weary soul
The weight of the world is pulling tight
She is dancing in the middle of the night
[Outro]
